Recovered original atlas ALT witnesses; complete-genome realignment; no allele-frequency denominator

catalog_metadata.benchmark_review_policy: All reviewers score 4 or 5: reviewed_support; all below 4: reviewed_low_quality; otherwise reviewed_mixed
catalog_metadata.evidence_scope: Legacy reported MS, author HLA mapping export, and separately licensed community spectrum reviews; not the complete 2026 Nature curated shotgun tables
catalog_metadata.initiation_policy: Loose positional Kozak preferences; no model filtering or calibrated initiation probability. Missing positions remain unknown; transcript boundaries are not verified cap sites.
catalog_metadata.model_scope: All 7264 complete stopped GENCODE Phase I and single-study ncORFs, including noncoding-transcript, internal and downstream ORFs

sources.citation: Ensembl release 101 human GRCh38 exon annotation and cDNA sequences
sources.mapping_scope: Exact entire ORF splice path and protein validated; reference context only, biological 5-prime completeness unverified

sources.citation: Kozak 1986, Point mutations define a sequence flanking the AUG initiator codon that modulates translation by eukaryotic ribosomes
sources.mapping_scope: Sequence prior, not measured initiation, expression, or an exclusion threshold

sources.citation: Mudge et al. 2022, Standardized annotation of translated open reading frames
sources.mapping_scope: No peptide uniqueness counts; legacy MS datasets are ORF-level pooled annotations, not peptide-specific sample attribution

sources.citation: Deutsch et al. 2026, Expanding the human proteome with microproteins and peptideins
sources.count_scope: Peptide PSMs across source MS runs, shared across ORF mappings; not RNA abundance or independent patient samples
sources.mapping_scope: n_pep in author's filtered HLA reference mappings, excluding canonical peptides; not global proteome uniqueness

sources.citation: Wacholder et al. 2026, Community benchmarking and evaluation of human unannotated microprotein detection by mass spectrometry based proteomics
sources.correction: 10.1038/s41467-026-73431-3 corrects figure labels, not source spectra
sources.mapping_scope: Sequence-compatible Phase I models; source_orf only when a published ORF alias also matches; uniqueness unknown

interpretation: Passes reuse the same original molecules; never pool their support. Extra ORF models and annotated CDS competitors remain separate. Local sequence candidates are not measured translation.
